legend: Karyotype showing 54 chromosomes with trisomies of the X chromosome and chromosomes 4, 6, 14, 17, and 18, and tetrasomy 21 (<<#31833>>). A flow cytometry–based DNA index showing a peak of 1.2, consistent with a diagnosis of B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma with high hyperdiploidy (<<#31828>>). Interphase FISH analysis using dual-colour/dual-fusion ETV6::RUNX1 probes indicates four discrete copies of RUNX1, consistent with gain of chromosome 21 (<<#31829>>).
